Markov-switching state-space models with applications to neuroimaging

Published in Computational Statistics & Data Analysis, 2022

Recommended citation: D. Degras, C.-M. Ting, H. Ombao, Volume 174, 2022, Article 107525. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.csda.2022.107525

This work develops statistical methods for Markov-switching state-space models with multiple latent regimes. The methods address likelihood-based inference, initialization and acceleration of the EM algorithm, and parametric bootstrap. Applications include EEG data from epilepsy and motor-imagery studies.

Publication record and DOI · MATLAB toolbox
